issues.description: Class-name mismatch for the concrete animal types: the exercise specification and template expect classes named Seal, Pig, and Goat (UML and template Main.java), but the solution repository provides implementations named SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat while Seal.java, Pig.java, and Goat.java in the solution are empty. This divergence between expected class identifiers (Seal/Pig/Goat) and provided implementations (SpaceSeal/SpacePig/SpaceGoat) will break students' ability to compile/use the provided Main/template code and will confuse them about which classes they must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the concrete class names consistent across artifacts. Options: (A) Rename the solution classes SpaceSeal, SpacePig, SpaceGoat to Seal, Pig, Goat and ensure their constructors and methods match the specification; or (B) add concrete wrapper/alias classes named Seal, Pig, Goat that delegate to the existing Space* implementations (preserving the same constructors and method behavior); or (C) update the problem statement, template, and tests to consistently require SpaceSeal/SpacePig/SpaceGoat. Choose one approach and apply it consistently so the class names used in the template, tests, and solution match the documented UML and task descriptions.
